text: dsh-ask-guard 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的超时保护插件，为 ask_user_question 工具调用设置协作式截止时间。它通过 tools/execute 事件拦截该提问工具，将带截止时间的 signal 交给后续处理；超时后返回包含 ASK_TIMEOUT 错误码和 AskTimeoutError 名称的结构化结果，正常回答则原样返回，其他工具不受影响。适合希望提问页面断连或无人回答时让 agent 回合结束、而不是一直等待的用户。默认超时为 300000 毫秒，可在 bundle 配置中调整；不需要额外 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-ask-guard adds a cooperative deadline to DSH Web ask_user_question calls. On timeout it returns an ASK_TIMEOUT error; answers and other tools pass through unchanged. The bundle sets a 300000 ms default. No API key or external service is required.
用户一直没答复时，能不能让提问自动超时？
网页断开后别让 DSH 回合无限卡住。
我想给 ask_user_question 设置等待时限。
让用户确认的问题到点后返回明确的超时错误。
DSH 的提问页面没人操作时该怎么结束等待？
我希望正常回答照常通过，只给用户提问加超时。
How can I stop an unanswered user question from hanging a turn forever?
Add a configurable deadline to ask_user_question calls in DSH.
dsh-ask-guard 的功能「提问超时」：拦截 ask_user_question 工具调用并设置截止时间。达到时限后，中断信号传给提问处理方，避免调用无限等待。
dsh-ask-guard 的功能「结构化超时结果」：超时后返回带 ASK_TIMEOUT 错误码和 AskTimeoutError 名称的错误结果及说明文字，供调用方识别。
dsh-ask-guard 的功能「选择超时时长」：通过 timeoutMs 配置 deadline；默认值为 300000 毫秒，加载时要求它是正整数，可在 bundle 的 ask-guard 配置中覆盖。
dsh-ask-guard 使用协作式取消；超时能否终止等待取决于下游提问处理方是否响应 signal。

dsh-ask-guard README · dsh-ask-guard：Timeout guard for `ask_user_question` in DeepSeek Harness: a lost or
unanswered question resolves as a structured `ASK_TIMEOUT` instead of hanging
the turn forever.

dsh-ask-guard README · The problem：The question card is delivered to the browser over a single push on the mux
WebSocket. When the page is backgrounded, the laptop sleeps, or the connection
dies half-open, the frame is lost, the client never notices (no heartbeat), and
the tool waits forever — observed hangs of 6+ hours, recoverable only by
pressing Stop. Upstream report:
[deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#1554](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1554).

dsh-ask-guard README · What this plugin does：It registers a `tools/execute` wrapper that arms a cooperative deadline on
every `ask_user_question` dispatch (the same mechanism as the official
`dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy`, which only enforces budgets declared by tool
plugins — `ask_user_question` declares none).

dsh-ask-guard README · What this plugin does：- When the deadline wins, the waiting provider's abort handler fires: the web
  provider broadcasts `question/resolved cancelled`, so the stuck composer
  (if any) is cleaned up.
- The wrapper then replaces the normalized abort with a structured error result
  (`code: ASK_TIMEOUT`, `name: AskTimeoutError`) with a model-facing message, so
  the agent can end the turn gracefully instead of blocking.
- All other tools pass through untouched.

dsh-ask-guard README · What this plugin does：The timeout is **cooperative** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-timeout` notifies via
`exec.signal`; the web user-questions provider honors the signal, so it
terminates for real).

dsh-ask-guard README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ask-guard
```

Restart `dsh web`. The plugin is a `dsh.bundle` package, so its patch row is
added to the profile composition automatically on reconcile.

Install from a git checkout instead:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Q1hangL/dsh-ask-guard
```

dsh-ask-guard README · Config：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `timeoutMs` | `300000` | Deadline for one `ask_user_question` call (ms). |

Tune it in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: ask-guard
  config:
    timeoutMs: 600000
```

dsh-ask-guard README · Recovery note：A page refresh (F5) re-syncs pending questions — the host replays unanswered
questions to a reconnecting client. With this plugin, even without a refresh
the turn no longer hangs forever.

dsh-ask-guard README · Test：```bash
npm install
node --test
```
